comparison.objective: Secure a carton to a cart with a stretched bungee and verify retention; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Stretch an elastic cord and hook both ends against tension versus fine hex-socket engagement, collar rotation, relocking, and test-control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Hooks remain home and carton retained through a cart motion test versus two force- and travel-compliant carriage stops with no collar drift.
comparison.reason: Both include post-manipulation physical testing, but elastic restraint assembly is not adjustable damping commissioning.
